import numpy as np
from tools.triad_dynamic_joint import BlockProjection
p=BlockProjection.make(64,64.0,((0.0,0.0),),())
print('indices', p.indices.tolist(), 'count', len(p.indices))
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
for dtype in (np.complex64,np.complex128,np.float32,np.float64,np.int16):
    x=(rng.normal(size=(3,2,4,64))+1j*rng.normal(size=(3,2,4,64))) if np.issubdtype(dtype,np.complexfloating) else rng.normal(size=(3,2,4,64))
    x=x.astype(dtype)
    got=p.numpy(x)
    alt=(x.astype(np.complex128).sum(axis=-1,keepdims=True)/np.sqrt(64))[...,p.indices]
    delta=np.abs(got-alt)
    print(dtype.__name__, got.shape, got.dtype, alt.dtype, 'max_abs',float(delta.max()),'allclose',bool(np.allclose(got,alt,rtol=1e-14,atol=1e-14)))
# Public callers use vector observation and [3,candidate,tap,row] basis.
for shape in ((64,), (3,2,2,64)):
    x=(rng.normal(size=shape)+1j*rng.normal(size=shape)).astype(np.complex128)
    print('caller_shape',shape,'output',p.numpy(x).shape,'dtype',p.numpy(x).dtype)
